criteria.criterion: AC1: GET /projects/:slug/codeintel/impact endpoint returns ChangeImpactResult schema
criteria.notes: Endpoint defined at projects.controller.ts:176 with @Get(':slug/codeintel/impact'). Returns JsonResponse.Ok(result) containing commitHash, changedFiles, impactedSymbols, impactedServices, impactedTickets, impactScore.

criteria.criterion: AC2: impactedSymbols contains symbols whose file matches changedFiles
criteria.notes: ImpactAnalysisService.getImpactedSymbols() queries Symbol table filtered by projectId and file IN changedFiles.

criteria.criterion: AC3: impactedServices linked to symbols through sourceFile/sourceId
criteria.notes: getImpactedServices() calls entityGraph.getRelatedEntities(projectId, symbol.id, depth=1) and filters for SERVICE and CODE_MODULE entities.

criteria.criterion: AC4: impactedTickets linked to impacted services
criteria.notes: getImpactedTickets() calls entityGraph.getRelatedEntities(projectId, service.entityId, depth=2) and filters for TICKET entities.

criteria.criterion: AC5: impactScore 0-100 with weighted formula and zero-denominator guards
criteria.notes: calculateImpactScore() implements: 0.3*(symbols/total*100) + 0.3*(services/total*100) + 0.2*(tickets/total*100) + 0.2*(incidents>0?100:0). Uses Math.max(1,length) for denominators to prevent division by zero. Clamped to [0,100] with Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score)).

criteria.criterion: AC6: Provenance included when ticketId provided
criteria.notes: Conditional logic: if (ticketId) { result.provenance = { ticketId, sources: buildSources(...) } }. Provenance omitted when ticketId is undefined.

criteria.criterion: AC7: Response completes in under 5 seconds for 50 changed files
criteria.notes: Implementation is reasonably efficient (single symbol lookup + entity graph traversal). No performance testing possible due to test infrastructure issues, but algorithm should complete well within 5s for 50 files.

criteria.criterion: AC8: Returns 403 for non-permitted users, 401 when missing auth
criteria.notes: Endpoint decorated with @RequiredPermission([CaslPermissionAction.READ, 'CodeIntel']). Controller uses PermissionAuthGuard via global guards. No inline role checks.
